description.value: Pizza Man is a locally-owned neighbourhood pizzeria in Mission, BC, built around a signature multigrain dough, house-recipe sauces, and real Canadian cheese. The menu spans 16 combination pizzas and 10 gourmet pies—including tandoori chicken, butter chicken, and several vegetarian builds—plus individual slices, making it a practical stop for a quick mid-ride meal. The shop delivers within a 5 km radius and is open seven days a week from late morning through the evening.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pizzamanmission.com is live and corroborates the OSM address (#4 – 33093 – 7th Ave., Mission BC) and phone (604-820-7797). The menu lists multiple vegetarian pizzas (Vegetarian Classic, Garden Combo, Vegetarian Paneer Pizza), confirming vegetarian options. Takeout is confirmed by pizza-by-the-slice counter service and a delivery program; no evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pizza Man' but the website domain and site title consistently use 'Pizzaman Mission' — minor branding inconsistency, not a serious discrepancy.

Hours listed on the website front page and contact page differ from each other and from OSM opening_hours tag; hours were not recorded per schema rules but the inconsistency may indicate the website is not kept fully up to date.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible pizza restaurant with a live website and confirmed contact details; a practical food stop for cyclists passing through Mission.

Takeout.detail: Pizza by the slice available ($2.25/slice per website); counter/takeout service implied throughout; delivery also offered

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Vegetarian Classic (mushrooms, onions, green peppers, pineapple, olives, tomatoes), Garden Combo (mushrooms, spinach, onions, green peppers, olives, artichokes, tomatoes), and Vegetarian Paneer Pizza

wow_evidence: locally-owned neighbourhood pizzeria in Mission, BC
